name: behavioral-testing
description: Tests that can actually fail. Writing guidance (expected values from the spec, proof the test fails on the bug, no silent test edits, no building to the test), a test-suite audit that proves weak tests with surviving mutants, a gated repair flow, and fail-to-pass bug reproduction. Five worker agents and two hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Tests that can actually fail: write, audit, repair, reproduce.
interface.longDescription: Writing guidance built on four questions (where did the expected value come from; would it fail on wrong code; did I change a test to pass; did I satisfy the check or do the job), a test-suite audit that proves weak tests with surviving mutants, a repair flow where every change carries proof, and fail-to-pass bug reproduction judged on three code states. Hooks remind at the moment a test passes and flag edits that silence tests.
defaultPrompt: Audit our test suite: which tests would actually go red if the code were wrong?
Write a failing test that reproduces this bug before we fix it.
